text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,810.85, up 1.58% on the day and 4.66% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.25% (5‑day gain 3.61%). Advances outpaced declines (311 vs 179) and the breadth score held at 49.6 in a neutral zone, indicating a fairly wide‑ranging rally. The India VIX, a volatility gauge, ticked higher to 15.72 (+1.42%), suggesting modest uncertainty despite the upward move.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹7,284.03 crore today and a cumulative ₹21,705.89 crore over five days, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹3,712.23 crore (‑₹7,957.44 crore over five days). Leading sectors were Infrastructure, Capital Markets, Pharma and Oil & Gas, whereas IT, Media and Private Bank stocks showed weakness. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.07 for Nifty, a max‑pain level near 23,800 and a call wall at 25,000, indicating modest bearish hedging pressure.

Watch the Nifty 50 support at 23,592 (S1) and resistance at 23,920 (R1); a break below 23,592 could test the 200‑day moving average (24,017). For Bank Nifty, the key levels are 55,229 (S1) and 55,795 (R1). Keep an eye on US mid‑term election outcomes, gold’s 3% rise and the USD‑INR at 94.63, as they may influence risk appetite and currency pressure in the next session.
